we-rock-spectrum-northern-kentucky: The field-trip contract prohibits adult equipment use and says an adult riding the zipline will be asked to leave. Its combined adults/older-teens sentence also contains a disability-related exception whose scope is unclear. Confirm age eligibility and assistance arrangements before booking.

EQUIPMENT USAGE: No adults are permitted on equipment for safety reasons. Adults and older teens (unless they have special needs) are strictly forbidden to go on the zipline. If an adult goes down the zipline, they will be asked to leave the facility immediately.

For school field trips, first-time visitors under 18, including infants, need a signed waiver before entering the gym floor. The branch offers a waiver file schools can distribute as an alternative to online registration.

WAIVERS: Any children (anyone under the age of 18, including infants) who have not been to our gym previously need to have signed liability waivers before entering the gym floor. Families can register children and agree to the liability forms at https://werockthespectrumnorthernkentucky.com/register. We can also send you a file with our waiver for you to distribute to your students if that works better.
